title: The Bright Protocol
author: Rafael Montrose
blurb: Dominic Underhill, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
